text_block_list.text:
The cafeteria at lunchtime.
In the sea of occupied seats, one peculiar space stood out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (Even if there are empty seats... it's awkward to ask to share a table.)
(Even if there are empty seats... it's hard to ask to share a table, isn't it.)

text_block_list.text:
However, it feels a bit lonely just watching.
As her Trainer, I should share a table with her—!

Oh! That spot over there is open!
Heyyy! Come on over here, look-see!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness Ramonu's spot was free~!
Right, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to have a table that can fit all the dishes.
Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Come now♪ Ramonu-chan, join us,
and let's all enjoy this delicious treat together♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.
And on the following day—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm sitting next to the Prez~♪
Oh, Tsuru-chan, you sit across from me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? Teio-chan, that's not fair!
I wanted to sit next to the President too—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No~pe! Tsuru-chan is so pure and innocent, you know!
She won't be able to protect the President from your devilish clutches, right~?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Ramonu.
I've been telling them not to make such a big deal out of it, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Y-You're so right!! It feels like it's just the two of them in their own little world... I'm so jealous!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Riiight~~~!? So President,
you're banned from talking to Ramonu today!

—And just like that,
her lunchtime turns out to be surprisingly lively.
choice_data_list: (...Looks like I was worrying over nothing.)
(...Looks like I was worrying for nothing.)

text_block_list.text:
"And in the afternoon. As I prepared for training
while reminiscing about all the lively excitement..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
For the second half of the menu,
we'll do a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I do not care how many there are, nor who they might be.
As long as they are opponents worthy of competing against.
choice_data_list: (Anyone, huh... Ah, then in that case!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'm gonna give it my all today~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad you invited me.
I'm counting on you."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ready, Tsuru-chan?
It's Operation A! Plan A!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Strategy A, Roger! ...Alright!
I'll protect the President with everything I've got!
choice_data_list: So, I got matching ones for our lunch group!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Lunch buddies?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Aptly put.
Indeed, we just had lunch together today as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Was that so, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up, hold up, hold up!
What about us?! We were just talking to you!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We weren't even on their radar...!?
They didn't even acknowledge our existence...!?

...Or rather, she just wasn't interested and forgot.
Mejiro Ramonu's interest in anything other than racing is virtually zero.

"At this rate,
a rift will form in our future interactions.
I have to do something—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
let's win this race and make sure they remember us♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah... The memories of eating together make the food taste even better.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of a delicious meal,
let's make this an unforgettable race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Merely scratching at the surface won't be enough.
You need to carve it in much deeper."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Merely scratching at the surface won't be enough.
You need to carve it in much deeper."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Fufun! Enjoy acting so relaxed while you still can!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Th-They look tough, but you can do it, Tsuyoshi!
Don't give up, Tsuyoshi! Woaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Our fighting spirit is more than ready.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That's enough chatter.
If you have anything more to say, do it on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll take my... time teasing you.
So that my love is burned in... deep and rich.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...I still have no clue what's going on, as usual,
but either way, I'm not gonna lose!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to the food.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Then in the name of a delicious meal,
let's give it our absolute all~♪
